usage: hash computation in canonical_digest and compute_compiled_digest

clause: compute_compiled_digest is sensitive to all source changes
evidence: compute_compiled_digest runs blake3::hash over raw source bytes, which includes all ask fields

detail: Changing ask prompt or timeout does not change the canonical digest embedded in CompiledWorkflow
